description.en: With MLS Season Pass, you can watch every match—including playoffs, Leagues Cup, and MLS Cup—like never before, no matter where you live. Watch live with no blackouts or restrictions with DIRECTV, the DIRECTV app, the Apple TV app across Apple devices, smart TVs, streaming devices, set-top boxes, game consoles, and on the web at tv.apple.com. Step into the game!

descriptionsByKey.long-myatt: MLS Season Pass subscription required. Apple ID/login required to stream via the Apple app. Subscription renews monthly during current regular season and automatically renews each season at the then-prevailing rate (currently $14.99/mo. during the MLS regular season for up to 8 months) unless canceled or you opt-out of auto-renewal. Cancel anytime online at directv.com or by calling 800.531.5000. No refunds or credits for any partial-month periods or unwatched content. If you cancel MLS Season Pass, you can continue to access it through any remaining monthly period.
